assertions.description: Before `UNPACK_SAMPLES(w)` reads the next row from `srcbuffer`, the bytes already consumed from `decode->unpacked_buffer` plus the upcoming `w * bpc` read must not exceed `decode->chunk.unpacked_size`. The crashing witness violates this bound at the protected read.
The chunk unpack size computed from file-controlled scanline and channel sampling state is carried unchanged into the later read bound used to protect `generic_unpack`.
The exact upcoming byte requirement checked at `root` is the same upcoming byte requirement consumed by `UNPACK_SAMPLES(w)` at the sink.

In the vulnerable execution, the total bytes needed for the current read exceed the bytes already consumed before that read, showing the sink is attempting an additional forward read rather than re-reading already consumed data.
